decisions: Preserve original identity at power one and at nonpositive or NaN power. Nonfinite cases are observations of the compatibility fold, not a new serialized content validation policy.
Retain structural effects and their nested references; clone only the original scaled shapes and nested fields. Preserve own keys, including explicit undefined.
Resource gains may commit before a host callback throws; do not retry the effect or run the remaining rider tail automatically.
Delayed bursts capture position, tier and causal depth at scheduling, while owner level and team are observed at resolution.
Remove a due burst before applying it. Owner death does not cancel it. A new due burst enqueued during resolution waits until the next pass.
Keep programmatic combo effects and the additional birth branch in the scope inventory.
limitations: One original native representative per branch does not cover every conditional path or authored row.
Native traces capture the documented actor/world fields and real method calls, not every internal field or renderer pixel.
Additional cooldown, cleanse, spatial tie, summon-cap, null-target, cast continuation and resource-variant observations are required before extracting those paths.
No standalone effect capability, cross-engine package, performance improvement or device compatibility is established by baseline acceptance.
